content.title: Modernization recommendation
content.body:
## Modernize the customer analytics estate into data products

Three overlapping reporting pipelines all re-derive customer and order facts from raw CRM and billing extracts. Recommend publishing two **source-aligned** products — a canonical **Customer Master** (from the CRM) and an **Orders** product (from the billing system) — then rebuilding the churn/marketing workloads as a single **consumer-aligned** product, **Customer 360 Features**, that CONSUMES both. The churn feature product needs customer demographics + order recency/frequency/monetary aggregates.

content.title: Proposed Customer 360 Features contract (draft)
content.body:
apiVersion: v3.1.0
kind: DataContract
name: Customer 360 Features
domain: customer
description: Per-customer demographics + RFM order aggregates for churn/marketing.
schema:
  - name: customer_features
    properties:
      - name: customer_id
        logicalType: string
        required: true
      - name: signup_date
        logicalType: date
      - name: orders_last_90d
        logicalType: integer
      - name: revenue_last_365d
        logicalType: number
      - name: last_order_at
        logicalType: timestamp
